d:
Asha Bhosle's distinctive voice, Rajesh Khanna's charm and Helen's unforgettable screen presence come together in Maine Dil Abhi Diya Nahin from the classic film The Train (1970). Composed by the legendary R. D. Burman, this lively Bollywood number captures the musical spirit of the 70s.
Maine Dil Abhi Diya Nahin | The Train (1970) | Rajesh Khanna, Helen | Asha Bhosle's Evergreen Song
Song : Maine Dil Abhi Diya Nahin
Movie: The Train (1970)
Star Cast: Rajesh Khanna, Helen
Singer: Asha Bhosle
Music Director: R D Burman
Lyricist: Anand Bakshi
